title: Visual builder Gallery and Testimonials modules

entries.summary: Catalog/normalize/render Gallery (2–4 col image grid, max 12) and Testimonials (quote/name/role/photo). URLs use safeUrl; captions and quotes are escaped. No lightbox JS.
Custom inspectors use data-gal-* and data-tml-* (not carousel slide attrs). Uploads can target a gallery/testimonial item. Canvas shows thumbs or quote names.
No schema change. Items live in layout_json; photos that are Media library files restore with uploads.
